key_insight: The paper builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing many candidates with visible-range band gaps and a substantial half-metallic subset.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates screening of perovskite compositions for photovoltaics, spintronics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking chemistry to electronic and magnetic behavior.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations for >2,500 Cs2BB'X6 halide double perovskites
Spin-polarized density of states plus band-gap classification across X = I, Br, Cl, F
LOBSTER bonding analysis with UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports DOS data for more than 2,500 compounds, including 719 visible-range band-gap materials and 118 half-metals.
watch_item: Predictions are computational and limited to compositions judged stable by the tau tolerance factor, so experimental validation is still needed before device use.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
